passages.title: BC Greens 2026: Our Plan for British Columbia (platform)
passages.quote: Institute selective logging and value-added industries to create sustainable jobs. Fully fund old-growth deferrals, with fair compensation for First Nations and forestry communities. Modernize our mining laws to protect communities and prioritize the resources BC needs for a renewable revolution.
